additionalConcreteEdgeReview.note: An initial inference about older HTMLParser RCDATA behavior did not reproduce on bundled Python 3.12.14. The proposed revision was not created; sealed r01 bytes remained unchanged.

allowlistContract.planSha256: Exact approved current plan SHA256 supplied by caller
allowlistContract.paths: Normalized Windows-safe NFC relative paths; duplicate IDs, case-colliding paths, reports, extra/missing fields and layouts HOLD.
allowlistContract.callerCoverageResponsibility: Caller binds this typed routing allowlist to the entire approved publication document set and actual final artifacts. Projection validates structure and exact paths but does not independently read the approved plan or prove artifact existence.

routingContract.origin: Frozen HTML href paths resolve from the selected document's md/<canonical.md> origin.
routingContract.targets: Only exact four-format allowlisted targets; retain target identity and extension. Markdown links remain Markdown links.
routingContract.modifiedBytes: Only raw UTF-8 a[href] value path spans. No DOM serialization or MD, labels, prose, images, CSS, other attributes, scripts, comments or raw-container literal text rewrite.
routingContract.preservation: Original external http(s)/data href bytes, original query spelling, target explicit component encoding, source BOM/line endings and all non-href bytes retained.
routingContract.localFragments: ALL HOLD pending actual anchor proof, including self fragments. HOLD details preserve exact raw query and fragment spelling. No anchor inputs or additional target reads.
routingContract.proof: Exact original/final SHA256, every replacement's original/final byte offsets and raw values, target identity/format, route records, inverse reconstruction equal to original bytes.
routingContract.converterInput: Original untouched canonical HTML remains XLSX/PDF converter input. Routed HTML is a transparent derived final-delivery candidate.

cli.readBoundary: Owned current WORK/REPORT files with exact extensions and pins; capsule snapshot and author jobs excluded; symlinks/reparse ancestors rejected before IO.
cli.writeBoundary: Fresh owned child of WORK/delivery/html-routing-results only. Windows-safe components, no overwrite; output/source overlap is outside permitted inputs.
cli.productionBinding: Outer binding must pin original renderer/MD provenance, approved allowlist identity and complete plan coverage, route receipt, final target actual files and source-before/after. Candidate receipt retains explicit native/coverage/atomic proof limits.
